Each model is projected independently. An outright party majority requires 51 seats. Independent/other seats remain unassigned to either party. The fixed baseline is 32 Democratic, 31 Republican and 2 independent seats. The original projection uses all 100 draw positions and allocates 35 contests to the largest average voting-category probability, excluding “Would not vote”. 25 dots per party; each dot represents approximately 4% of that party’s 10,000 resamples. Estimates ± SE use all resamples and appear inside the plot. These distributions and standard errors reflect cohort-resampling variation only.
